blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero on Thursday reminded his fellow senator-judges to refrain from threatening witnesses with the use of their contempt powers or making insulting remarks against them. In recent days, some senator-judges, including Escudero himself, have expressed displeasure with defense witnesses who softened their testimonies or could not recall questions asked of them. READ: Assessor’s evasive answers draw ire of senator-judges “The chair wishes to emphasize that an answer which may be unsatisfactory is not inherently contemptible.
